# Adorable Science: code map

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Fuzzy-hearted, well-sourced science news written by the community. Anyone can write an article; Lab Directors review every one before it is published.
**Live:** https://adorablescience.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/adorablescience · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/adorablescience/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py adorablescience` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Native Forms since Nov 2026** (branch `forms`, folder adorablescience-forms). Server code is the classic app's,
  unchanged: friendly errors come back as `{"__oops__": msg}` (Lab.py `@api`), not `{"ok": False}`. Pages load with
  `api.load` (raises `api.LabError` -> router opens Pages/Problem); buttons use `state.call` (toast + None).
- **Addresses** are the old ones: `#` (front), `#topic/x`, `#article/N`, `#writers`, `#writer/uid`, `#me`, `#write[/N]`,
  `#lab`, `#join[/<return address>]`, `#review[/N]`. Members-only pages redirect to `#join/<address>`. The bare `#` reads
  as `location.hash == ""` in the browser: compare with `(location.hash || '#')` in tests.
- **First person to sign in becomes the first Lab Director** (Accounts.get_me). ui_test.py therefore starts each new
  container with a fresh database and every script signs in `director@example.com` first (tools/ui/lib.js `T.director`).
  The test copy of anvil.yaml turns `confirm_email` off (the live app keeps it on).
- Empty front page publishes 5 sourced starter articles on the first visit (Starters.ensure_starters).
- **Text goes in with textContent** (client_code/bits.py fills chips, badges, bylines into template dom-nodes); the only
  innerHTML is the article body/preview, which server_code/Render.py builds from escaped text.
- Root elements of item templates have no click handlers (App Server 1.18 ignores `anvil:on-dom` on a root): Items/Pick
  wraps its button in `<span class="as-pick">` (display: contents).
- Anvil DropDown `<option value>`s are its own, not the keys: tests pick options by their text.
- Look: app.css = the old theme.css look + design kit + a dark theme (`--as-line`, `--as-shadow`, `--as-on-ink`,
  `--as-accent` tokens); Bea's SVG uses fixed colours so she stays a light sticker on dark. Emoji are the icons and the
  graph paper / sticker shadows are deliberate (`design-ok`). theme.css only draws the Bea spinner.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **articles**: specimen_no:num, title:str, dek:str, body:str, category:str, evidence:str, cover:str, author→users, status:str, created:dt, updated:dt, submitted_at:dt, published_at:dt, reviewer→users, review_note:str, featured:bool, boops:num, n_sources:num, n_cited:num, reading_min:num · used in Accounts, Articles, Lab, Review, Starters
- **boops**: article→articles, user→users, at:dt · used in Articles, Lab
- **lab_log**: article→articles, actor→users, action:str, note:str, at:dt · used in Articles, Lab
- **sources**: article→articles, position:num, url:str, title:str, publisher:str, kind:str · used in Articles, Lab, Starters
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, uid:str, display_name:str, avatar:str, specialty:str, bio:str, website:str, is_admin:bool, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Accounts, Lab, Starters

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
